qa_pair.question: Study A expects a standardized effect of d=0.5 and Study B expects d=0.8; both use a two-sided alpha of 0.05 and 80% power in a two-group comparison. How many more participants per group does Study A need than Study B?
Three studies report effects 0.2, 0.4 and 0.6 with standard errors 0.1, 0.1 and 0.2. What is the fixed-effect pooled estimate, rounded to two decimals?
A paper reports group means 5.18, 5.19 and 5.20 from integer-valued questionnaire data with n=28 per group. How many of these three means are impossible?
With units F in N, m in kg, a in m/s**2, E in J and v in m/s, how many of these equations are dimensionally consistent: F = m*a, E = m*v, E = m*v**2/2?
A paper reports t(28)=2.10 with p=.045, t(28)=1.20 with p=.03, and t(28)=2.10 with p=.01. How many of the three reports are NOT consistent with the recomputed p-value?

Four studies report effects 0.1, 0.9, 0.5 and 1.3, each with standard error 0.1. Under a random-effects meta-analysis, what is I-squared rounded to the nearest whole percent?
